description_en: Queries the diagnostics results of the storage layer
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-worker-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2021-11-18T00:00Z --end-time 2024-04-25T02:04Z --lang zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWorkerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a region, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612293.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the query time range. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
